title: Worksheet 2: Binary Numbers (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Computers do not understand words or numbers the way people do. Instead, computers store and process all information using only two digits: 0 and 1. This number system is called binary. Each 0 or 1 is called a "bit," which is short for "binary digit." Inside a computer, a bit is stored as an electrical signal that is either off (0) or on (1). By grouping bits together in different patterns, computers can represent letters, numbers, colors, and even sounds. For example, the pattern 01000001 can represent the letter "A" in one common computer code. Eight bits grouped together are called a "byte." The word "binary" comes from a Latin word meaning "two," because the system only uses two possible digits.
